clips.title: The story
paras: At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel advances Forsaken alchemy in Silverpine Forest. He studies the region’s corrupted wildlife and undead threats, and travelers help gather volatile reagents and investigate Scourge remnants.

At the Sepulcher, Renferrel leads field research for the Royal Apothecary Society in Silverpine Forest. The society’s grand laboratories and high leadership are in Undercity, while he handles the work in the field. He secures native biological specimens, refines potent concoctions, and studies the grim ecology along Lordaeron’s western border.
